name: Parasite Dawn
source: Parasite Dawn is about a modern town which comes under the dark and sexy influence of a parasite which gives people the body of their dreams. However, that comes at the cost of their minds. Follow the Empress in her takeover of this town, and the various people that will fall to her rule. Or maybe, they will resist instead...
translation: 《寄生虫黎明》讲述了一座现代小镇的故事，这座小镇受到了寄生虫的黑暗和性感的影响，寄生虫赋予了人们梦想中的身体。然而，这是以他们的思想为代价的。跟随女皇接管这座城镇，以及将落入她统治之下的各种人民。或许，他们会反抗……
